tasks.short: Monitor patient's physiological responses to therapy, such as vital signs, arterial blood gases, or blood chemistry changes, and consult with physician if adverse reactions occur.

steps.what: Read the posted arterial blood gases and chemistry changes.
Monitor the patient's physiological responses to therapy, including vital signs.
Consult the physician if adverse reactions occur.

tasks.design: The respiratory therapist reads a posted gas and chemistry line on {DOCS} when its fields are filled. The therapist still monitors the patient's physiological responses at the bedside, including vital signs, and still consults the physician in the room if adverse reactions occur. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: The gas and chemistry numbers sat in a free-text note, so the lookup could not start from named fields.
tasks.enabler_now: A posted line with named fields lets the therapist find the gases and the chemistry without hunting the note.
tasks.still_hard: An adverse reaction can show on the patient before a number moves, and harm comes from missing it.
tasks.human_edge: Only the therapist at the bedside can see the patient's response and decide to consult the physician.
tasks.altitude: The week is still the bedside. The therapist still monitors every patient and still consults the physician. The lookup is shorter only when the posted line is complete.

reach.task: Post the arterial blood gases and the blood chemistry for this patient.
reach.learn: A blank gas or a blank chemistry value is not a usable line, and the therapist still monitors the patient.

evidence.claim: Showing posted gas and chemistry fields on one line does not judge the patient. The therapist still monitors the responses and still consults the physician. Model knowledge.
A solely automated care decision needs an Article 22 basis. The therapist still decides whether adverse reactions have occurred, and this design stores nothing on its own.
A patient chatbot must disclose that it is AI from 2 August 2026. This design does not speak to the patient and is not a chatbot.
Recording that can check staff performance needs works-council consent. This design does not record the bedside.

assumptions: This task is one bedside watch. It starts when the gas and chemistry line is posted and ends when the therapist has monitored the patient and consulted the physician if adverse reactions occur. Posting the line is the laboratory technologist's work.

The line has four fields: patient, time, arterial blood gases, and blood chemistry. The laboratory technologist produces it, and that posting time stays on the laboratory. A blank gas or a blank chemistry value is not a usable line.

If the line is missing or free text, the read is not shorter. The therapist still monitors the patient and still consults the physician in the room. That consult is a talk with a colleague, not a send outside the organisation. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet. The design does not record the bedside. Existing document-store runtime is not human effort.
unknowns: Whether this hospital posts arterial blood gases and blood chemistry as named fields or as a scanned page.
research_questions: How often is the gas and chemistry line posted with every field rather than free text?

already_counted.description: Reading the gas and chemistry line, including a missing line, stays inside the read.
Monitoring the patient's physiological responses stays inside that step.
Consulting the physician stays inside that step.

incremental.description: When a field name on the gas and chemistry line changes, the therapist checks that the posted fields still match.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is zero when the gas and chemistry line is missing, so the read is not shorter. High is one line in five missing, so the shorter read applies on the other four, and the therapist still monitors every patient and still consults the physician. The high is not a consult-minute figure.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Relay blood analysis results to a physician.

steps.what: Read the posted blood analysis results.
Relay those results to the physician.

tasks.enabler_now: A posted line with named fields lets the therapist see the results before speaking to the physician.
tasks.still_hard: A result can be urgent in a way the line does not mark, and harm comes from a relay the physician misunderstands.
tasks.human_edge: Only the therapist who has the patient in view can relay what the result means for this hour.
tasks.altitude: The week is still the relay. The therapist still speaks every result to the physician. The lookup is shorter only when the posted line is complete.

Recording that can check staff performance needs works-council consent. This design does not record the relay.

tasks.short: Enforce safety rules and ensure careful adherence to physicians' orders.

steps.what: Read the posted physicians orders for this round.
Enforce safety rules and ensure careful adherence.

tasks.enabler_now: A posted order with named fields lets the therapist see the rule and the order before the round.
tasks.still_hard: A safety rule can conflict with the patient in the bed, and harm comes from enforcing the wrong order.
tasks.human_edge: Only the therapist in the room can enforce the safety rule against what is happening now.
tasks.altitude: The week is still the round. The therapist still enforces every safety rule and still adheres to the orders. The lookup is shorter only when the posted line is complete.

reach.task: Post the order for this patient before the round.
